address: 98 Chik Fuk Street, Tai Wai, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: The red lanterns at the entrance are a prelude to the nostalgic, Chinese-style interior. The kitchen team respects Cantonese traditions, but with a wry sense of humour. Dim sum dominates the menu at lunch, including all-time favourites like pan-fried sticky rice chicken dumpling. At dinner, painstaking old-fashioned recipes take centre stage. Try char siu glazed in maltose and seared tableside, or eight-treasure duck that needs pre-ordering....
